spent_amount: The queuing management is terrible. The wait times are extremely long. I had a 5 PM appointment but didn't get a slot until almost 7 PM, and every time I waited, it was about an hour. There's also the issue of the doctor not being available for the full month. Normally, patients see the doctor on the 26th or the end of this month/the next, but the doctor is unavailable, so they tell you to reschedule for the following month. Then, the clinic makes patients pay an extra 300 baht penalty??? Just because they didn't see the doctor that month, even though the doctor was unavailable! It's confusing! And the doctor's last day of work is a weekday afternoon! And they shouldn't have changed the equipment before the scheduled time either. The clinic should be aware of this. In short, I'm not continuing treatment there. This review is from a consumer who spent over 30,000 baht at this clinic, hoping the case would be resolved, but ultimately, I've moved to another clinic due to various issues.
